name: comp-118
title: Star Count Button
description: A light rounded button that invites a star rating. It groups a star icon, the label Star and a running count into one compact control.
use: A single tap should bookmark, favourite or upvote an item while showing how many others already did.
avoid: It is a plain button with no pressed look or counting logic, so you must add that behaviour yourself.
a11y: The star icon is hidden from screen readers and the count reads as plain text; no pressed state is announced. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pill-shaped light button on a dark stage. Inside, a thin outlined star, the bold word Star in near-black and a smaller grey count sit in one evenly spaced row.
behaves: The button stays still; only its surface reacts. Hovering shifts the light fill toward grey and pressing deepens it, then it settles back to off-white.
customise: The label, count and icon are written in the file, so changing them means editing the source; button size and variant follow the shared Button defaults.
weight: light: One button with an icon and two text spans; only a colour transition runs.
